brief:
Jared Kushner, the US president's son-in-law and special envoy, warned that Israel risks becoming a "pariah" as his Board of Peace initiative encounters obstacles, Middle East Eye reported. The project, which aimed to rebuild Gaza using Gulf funding, has faced delays and difficulty securing financial backing.

Kushner's efforts to marshal regional investment for Palestinian reconstruction have encountered resistance as international pressure on Israel intensifies. The venture was designed to attract Gulf Arab capital for Gaza's recovery, but the funding complications have derailed the timeline for the initiative's rollout.

title: Kushner's Gaza reconstruction plan stalls amid funding troubles
